lede: Wat Ban Hong Luang accounts for 13 catalogued manuscripts. It clusters in Lamphun (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (92%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (8%). Dated witnesses run 1825–1942 CE (8 of 13 carry a date).
